summary: A disclosed Reddit reply was posted to a live startup-cloud-credits discussion using dated Sourcey registry facts that directly answer the poster's questions about Google Cloud and AWS startup credits.

items.relevance: The live thread explicitly asks about AWS Activate and Google for Startups Cloud credit amounts and eligibility for an unfunded startup.
items.disclosure: The public comment states that it was posted while participating in a small paid bounty.

items.fact: The Google for Startups Cloud Program record lists Start up to $2,000 for one year, Scale up to $100,000 in year one, and an AI-first tier up to $250,000 in year one.

The AWS Activate Portfolio record lists up to $200,000 in AWS credits for pre-Series B startups applying with an AWS Activate Provider Org ID, and records a Founders route aimed at self-funded pre-Series B startups.
